name: Minotaur
description: A species of humanoid bull creatures found on many planes, fierce in combat and often very prideful.

timeline.summary: Before the Conflux, minotaurs lived in the canyons of Naya; afterwards they roam all of Alara.
timeline.quote: Before the Conflux , the minotaurs inhabited the deep canyons of Naya , but now roam the width and breadth of Alara freely

timeline.summary: The author recalls reading about Greek myth monsters such as the Kraken, Medusa and the Minotaur as a child.
timeline.quote: I devoured legends of the Minotaur, of harpies and centaurs, and of the Phoenix and the Cyclops as imagination nourishment.
